query: What signals suggest an expense will be declined?

per_column.name: asset_type_category
per_column.rationale: Categorizing the asset type gives a genuine grouping axis to test whether certain categories correlate with decline. Values are soundly read from short_description/ci, though 'iPod touch/ISP Services' mapped to software_service is a slightly loose call.

per_column.name: entry_origin
per_column.rationale: Origin of the entry (auto_generated vs manual vs asset_registration) is a plausible signal for decline risk. However some values are weakly grounded: 'manual_acquisition' for a Dell laptop or 'auto_generated' for a cloud service are inferred beyond what the terse text clearly states.

per_column.name: source_id_present
per_column.rationale: A presence flag on an existing column is trivially derivable and grounded, but it is largely a restatement of source_id and offers only marginal analytical leverage for the decline query.

per_column.name: processed_date_present
per_column.rationale: Whether the expense was processed is a reasonable proxy signal—unprocessed/missing dates may correlate with declines—so slightly more useful than a bare presence flag. Values exactly match the source (nan -> False).

per_column.name: ci_specificity
per_column.rationale: Specificity of the CI (named_model vs generic_label) is a plausible data-quality signal that could relate to declines. Classifications are well-grounded readings of the ci field.

per_column.name: vendor_brand
per_column.rationale: Vendor is a solid new grouping axis for decline analysis. Mostly grounded via ci/description, but 'ISP Services/iPod touch' -> 'Other_known' is a stretch, and the top-value legend shows 'Unknown' as NULL yet samples emit 'Unknown' for silent rows, which is acceptable behaviour.

judge.rationale: The added columns supply several genuine new axes (asset type, entry origin, vendor, CI specificity) plus two presence flags useful for a decline-signal analysis. The two boolean presence flags are the weakest on usefulness, being close restatements of existing columns. Groundedness is generally strong—values are sound readings of the source text and silent rows get reasonable Unknown/False values—with only occasional loose inferences (entry_origin, treating iPod/ISP as software_service/Other_known). No clear hallucinations of invented facts.
